source_units.text: Operations officer reviews each traveller document.
A traveller record stores name and passport number.
A traveller with an expired passport must not enter the final manifest.
When payment is accepted, the remaining balance is recalculated.
Finance records a payment, then Operations verifies the receipt.
A document changes from pending to approved after verification.
The operator uploads a passport scan.
The system produces a readiness report.
If the receipt is unreadable, the payment is rejected with a reason.
The approval threshold may be 40 or 45 travellers; confirm the policy.
This paragraph is an introductory greeting and contains no requirement.
